title: Chapter 258 The Pill Tribulation Appears
content:
Chapter 258 The Pill Tribulation Appears

The supreme sound came from the list of Immortal Emperors, and in an instant, it spread throughout the entire Immortal Realm.

After so many years, have another strong man from the Immortal Emperor Realm attacked the Immortal Emperor List? !

Suddenly, this news caused a stir in the entire fairyland like a bomb.

The terrifying thunder kept ripping from the sky in the center of the fairyland, and the world looked horrified.

Xiao Yin!

It's Xiao Yin!

The monster list that year was the top!

Many powerful people who wanted to rush to the Wood Fairy World to watch the showdown between the alchemy masters were instantly hesitant.

On one side is the peerless alchemy competition, and on the other side is the peak decisive battle standing at the top of the combat power of the fairy world.

Why did these two games happen at the same time?

Everyone was upset and didn't know how to choose for a while.

In the end, most people continued to choose to go to the Wood Fairy Realm to watch the alchemy competition.

Because the duels between the peak powerhouses of the Immortal Emperor Realm often take a long time to decide the winner, some take months, some take years, and even worse, there is no victory or defeat in the duel for a thousand years.

The second and third places on the list are now the battle for three thousand years before the final outcome was decided.

If the Immortal Emperor List had not provided a special combat space, otherwise you would have seen a stunning showdown.

But even so, the void that has been roaring for three thousand years still makes the world feel the horror of the battle.

I don't know how long it took.

Xiao Yin, who was standing in front of the Immortal Emperor List, suddenly disappeared from the spot.

At the same time, in a special space.

Two terrifying figures appeared here and stood opposite each other.

"It is really awesome for young people to achieve the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm in a million years!"

Opposite Xiao Yin, a middle-aged man wearing a purple star robe said in a low voice, with a slightly excited tone.

But then, he shook his head slightly again.

"It's a pity that you're still too impatient and lack some heat. Otherwise, I'd really probably won't beat you."

The implication is that you are too young now and are not my opponent.

When Xiao Yin heard this, he said lightly: "Is the heat enough? I will find out if I try it."

The next moment, the void collapsed!

.........

Wood fairy world, deserted city.

At this moment, the first alchemy competition has come to an end.

As a strong medicinal fragrance wafted out from the alchemy furnace in front of Jordan Yang, the entire square suddenly felt like a fairyland.

"Hahaha, it's done, it's done!"

Jordan Yang began to laugh wildly, his eyes filled with brilliance.

The recovery pill can quickly recover from injuries in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

It is no exaggeration to say that this pill can attract all the powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Sure enough, when Jordan Yang took out the elixir with the fragrance of the medicine in the elixir with distinct patterns, the entire square suddenly began to get restless.

Countless strong men looked at the pill in Jordanyang's hand.

"Master Qiao, I am willing to pay 50 million immortal crystals to buy this recovery pill!"

50 million, this price is definitely not low even for a strong man in the Immortal Emperor realm.

But buying the life of a strong man in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm for 50 million will make you a sure profit without losing money.

No one present thought the price was high, but he looked disdainful.

"I'll pay 80 million!"

"I'll pay 100 million!"

The bidding sounded one after another, and the entire square seemed to have become an auction site.

Jordanyang ignored everyone's bid, but instead stood up and walked to Xun Heng.

"Recovery pills, refine them."

Jordanyang handed the recovery pill in his hand to Xun Heng, and then looked at the other side with a smile on his face, in the direction of Shi Liantian.

However, the next moment, the smile on Jordanyang's face instantly frozen.

"That, that's!"

At this moment, the alchemy furnace in front of Shi Liantian was buzzing.

The strange black flame is gradually extinguishing.

Jordanyang's nose moved slightly, but he smelled nothing except the smell of medicine on his side.

Suddenly, Jordan Yang's expression became solemn.

And at this moment, in the void, black clouds suddenly began to condense.

The powerful and captivating pressure slowly overflowed from it.

Seeing this scene, everyone present was shocked.

That's the cloud of disaster!

Is anyone going to get through the tribulation? !

Jordanyang showed horror on his face, his lips trembled and said, "Dan, Dan Jiao!"

"This, how is this possible? This is just a recovery pill!"

Dan disaster.

This is the best evaluation of a pill.

When he once refined the elixir above the Immortal Emperor, he also attracted the robbery cloud.

Although he did not fall, it was enough to make him proud.

And now, the mysterious alchemist in front of him just refining the recovery pill and causing the alchemy disaster.

Is this really that big difference?

Jordanyang was sweating profusely, and this competition was really bullying.

I guess the guy opposite me may be extremely disdainful of me.

As a top alchemist in the fairy realm, Jordan is most arrogant and arrogant, and doesn't like anyone, but he naturally has the vision he should have.

He already knew the difference between himself and the alchemist in front of him very well.

This competition has ended from the beginning.

Jordan Yang smiled bitterly in his heart.

In the square, the alchemists also showed respect on their faces. This is the real alchemist.

They were as small as children in front of this person.

At this time, the alchemy furnace in front of Shi Liantian gradually stopped ringing.

As Shi Liantianyun calmed down, he took out a crystal clear elixir that was only the size of a fingernail from his own alchemy furnace.

The clouds of disaster in the void also began to slowly dissipate.

This pill only attracted the elixir, but it was not enough to make the elixir fall.

Unless Shi Liantian refines high-quality elixirs.

On the stage, Xun Heng saw that Shi Liantian had finished refining, and quickly shouted, "The first competition is over!"

Everyone looked at the pills in Shi Liantian's hand and showed disdain.

"This pill looks good, but it's not useful, it doesn't even taste like it."

"That's right, I'm still optimistic about Master Qiao's elixir."

"Yes, yes, Master Qiao's elixir is the best elixir."

Listening to these inexplicable squirting, some alchemists frowned.

Tan Songci, the tutor of Tiandi Academy, looked at Jordanyang's expression on the stage and guessed the ending.

"well."

Tan Songci couldn't help but sigh slightly.

The student of Tiandi Academy on the side said in confusion: "Teacher, why do you sigh?"

The disciples of the Alchemy Peak headed by Bai Lushuang were a little unbelievable.

They remember that the teacher once said that the elixir that can cause elixir disasters must be the best among elixirs, and the world cannot tolerate it.

The just-dispersed disaster cloud in the void is the best proof.

My own teacher lost.

Thinking of this, the disciples lowered their heads one after another, and some people even cried in a low voice.

Bai Lushuang's expression was extremely complicated.

She never thought that Master lost the first game.

And when the teacher performed so well, he lost so thoroughly.
